prerequisites: Minimum English language proficiency is recommended for software practices and understanding some readings (for Spanish-speaking students)

learning_outcomes.text: Model and solve problems related to the business system
Make decisions related to production management

assessment_methods.method: Average of practical exams P1, P2, P3, P4

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, a minimum score of 4 out of 10 is required for the theoretical block (T1) and a minimum of 4 out of 10 for the practical block. The theoretical block grade is 0.65 * T1. The practical block grade is 0.35 * [(P1 + P2 + P3 + P4)/4]. If both minimums are met, the final grade is Theory + Practices; otherwise, it is the minimum of the calculated grade and 4.0. For the extraordinary call, a theoretical exam and a practical exam evaluate the entire content. A minimum of 4 points out of 10 is mandatory for both theoretical and practical parts. If these minimums are met, the final grade is (0.65 * Theory) + (0.35 * Practices); otherwise, the grade is the minimum of the calculated grade and 4.0. Students with differentiated evaluation will have a single individual practical test replacing the multiple practical activities, while other conditions remain the same.
